plan.doc_literal_usage: converter = make_converter(); u = converter.unstructure({1, 2, 3}); assert isinstance(u, set), "Sets are serialized and deserialized to sets." # DOC-LITERAL
plan.argument_finding_is_false: The phrase could be read as referring to CBOR-level encoding (cbor2 can encode Python sets as CBOR sets) rather than cattrs unstructuring, but cattrs' make_converter explicitly sets unstruct_collection_overrides[Set] = list, so a converted set does not round-trip through unstructure as a set.

classification.error_excerpt: AssertionError: Sets are serialized and deserialized to sets.
